answer: Require sponsors to lock 100 coins in a vault for every new earning identity. Its first job pays at most 5 coins; randomly audit 10% of these jobs using independently verifiable delivery evidence, burning the sponsor bond for proven fabrication. A sponsor named zephyr cannot grow a free trellis of clones: each branch needs its own bond. With reliable audits, each fabricated first job risks a 10-coin expected bond loss against at most 5 coins of income. Extra identities multiply that cost.
